role: The vanilla client launcher: parses the jopt arguments (gameDir, assetsDir, session, width/height, proxy), builds the Session and constructs Minecraft, then hands the thread to Minecraft.run.
scope_reason: Every oracle run reaches this main: oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/Main.java:154 calls net.minecraft.client.main.Main.main(...) with the pinned argv, so this file is the real entry point of the oracle.

members.name: main
members.note: the native play driver's own main takes over the role: argument handling, the game loop and teardown; the Minecraft construction and shutdown hook are oracle/java side (netherite.oracle.Main builds the argv and the shutdown hook)
